map.代谢当量（MET）是运动强度单位，1 MET 约等于安静坐位耗氧 3.5 ml/: Metabolic equivalent (MET) is an exercise intensity unit; 1 MET ~ resting seated VO2 3.5 ml/(kg-min). Higher means harder: walk ~2-3 METs, jog ~7-8, intense sport >10.
